title: Uma manhã no café
grammar: Perguntas com was/were + -ing e respostas curtas
goal: Pergunte com Was/Were + sujeito + -ing e responda com Yes, I was ou No, I wasn’t.
reading: Tina was working at the café on Friday morning.
Tina estava trabalhando no café na sexta de manhã.
A man was waiting at the counter for his order.
Um homem esperava no balcão pelo pedido dele.
Tina was making coffee, but the motor was making a strange noise.
Tina fazia café, mas o motor fazia um barulho estranho.
The service was slow, so Lou was watching.
O atendimento estava lento, então a Lou só olhava.
They were laughing when the man finally got his coffee.
Elas riam quando o homem finalmente recebeu o café.
dialogue: Was the café busy on Friday?
O café estava movimentado na sexta?
Yes, it was. Many people were waiting.
No, I wasn’t. Lou was helping me.
Não. A Lou estava me ajudando.
No, he wasn’t. He was waiting with a smile on his lips.
Não. Ele esperava com um sorriso nos lábios.
Você estava fazendo o café dele?
Yes, I was. There was a long pause because of the motor.
Estava. Houve uma longa pausa por causa do motor.
pron: Em perguntas de sim ou não, como Were you working?, a voz sobe no fim.
gram: Com you, use were, mesmo no singular.
